alkylation_concentration.evidence: The samples were centrifuged at 16,000 xg for 15 min, and the supernatant was collected. Total protein concentration was determined using the BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific). Sample equivalent to 500 µg total protein was reduced with 25 mM dithiothreitol at 37°C for 1 h and alkylated with 60 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
